name: Greelwood Saber
description: The Greelwood Saber was crafted by the Ithorian Oorrl Morm to emphasize the Jedi maxims of defense and protection, rather than attack. With a rare pontite crystal mined from the crystal caves in the Eocho Mountains and a heavily lacquered greel-wood hilt, the lightsaber was made on the planet Ossus. After Morm's death, the lightsaber was interred within a vault in the Chamber of Antiquities.
